response.overview: This documentary offers a rare, intimate portrait of renowned artist Tullio Pericoli. Filmed patiently over a long period, the film captures him sketching landscapes and human faces, bridging artistic traditions from the Renaissance to the modern era. Blending art, memory, and autobiography, it traces his journey from a young dreamer arriving in 1960s Milan to an intensely private master of his craft.
response.tagline: Between the lines of a landscape and the depths of a human face.
response.title: La linea dell’orizzonte
